name: Varimathras
summary: In the Royal Quarter, Varimathras advises Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and commands her forces. Defeated during the civil war for Lordaeron, the dreadlord pledged himself to the Banshee Queen and now stands at her right hand in the Undercity.

sections.title: Jailor of the Lich King
sections.body: Before the Third War, Kil'jaeden sent Varimathras and his fellow dreadlords to Azeroth to guard the Lich King and ensure Ner'zhul's spirit served the Legion's plans. With his brothers Detheroc and Balnazzar, Varimathras oversaw the Scourge in Lordaeron while Archimonde invaded Kalimdor. The Legion fell at Mount Hyjal, but the three dreadlords remained entrenched in the ruins of the Capital City. They did not learn of their master's defeat until Prince Arthas returned and drove them into hiding.

sections.title: A Demon's Surrender
sections.body: As the Lich King's hold over his undead forces weakened, Varimathras tried to make the newly freed banshee Sylvanas Windrunner serve the dreadlords' new regime. Sylvanas refused and rallied liberated undead to destroy his outpost. Facing execution, Varimathras begged for his life and offered tactical secrets, including knowledge of his brothers' fortifications. Sylvanas spared him and bound him to her service as a weapon against his kin.

sections.title: Brother Against Brother
sections.body: Varimathras was ordered to kill his fellow dreadlord Balnazzar after the conquest of the Capital City to earn Sylvanas's trust. He seemed to obey, but Balnazzar survived the deception. At Sylvanas's command, Varimathras then executed the human warlord Grand Marshal Garithos. Now beside Sylvanas's throne, he coordinates military excursions across Lordaeron, while many in the Horde regard this demonic ally with deep unease.

faq.q: Why is a demon serving the Forsaken?
faq.answer: During the Lordaeron civil war, Sylvanas Windrunner led newly liberated undead against Varimathras's forces and defeated them. Facing death, he begged for mercy and offered his cunning, military knowledge, and service. Sylvanas spared him to serve as her tactician and enforcer.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Varimathras?
faq.answer: Varimathras is a nathrezim, or dreadlord. Nathrezim are intelligent, manipulative demons who serve the Burning Legion, using mental domination, shadow magic, plague, and discord.

faq.q: Where does Varimathras stand in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Varimathras stands on the dais in the Undercity's Royal Quarter, directly beside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and surrounded by Forsaken royal guards.

faq.q: What happened between Varimathras and Balnazzar?
faq.answer: After the conquest of the Capital City, Sylvanas ordered Varimathras to attack his brother Balnazzar as a test of loyalty. Varimathras turned on his fellow dreadlord at her command.

faq.q: What role did Varimathras play in creating the Scourge?
faq.answer: Kil'jaeden bound the orc shaman Ner'zhul's spirit inside the Frozen Throne and hurled it to Azeroth as the Lich King. He sent Varimathras and the other dreadlords to guard the Lich King and oversee the Scourge's work in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Do the other Horde leaders trust Varimathras?
faq.answer: No. The orcs, trolls, and tauren bear deep scars from demonic corruption and see dreadlords as monstrous manipulators. Many Forsaken also regard Varimathras as an uneasy weapon kept on a tight leash, not a true brother-in-arms.

angles.text: As an undead, you see Varimathras as proof that the Forsaken will turn their oppressors' weapons against them. He stands subdued beside the Dark Lady who freed Lordaeron from his grip.
As a warlock, you may find a high-ranking nathrezim serving a mortal undead queen an impressive, unsettling display of will.
As a member of the Horde, you find Varimathras's presence in the Undercity a source of friction with Orgrimmar. The Horde spent decades breaking free from the demonic masters he served.
